title: Recover API startup from temporary database DNS failures
why: The owner encountered ENOTFOUND for the configured Supabase pooler hostname. The API exited after its first failed connection probe, leaving Vite running with ECONNREFUSED proxy errors.

evidence.configuration: The existing explicit Postgres connection string targets the reported hostname on port 6543. No hostname, credentials or environment settings were changed.
evidence.diagnosis: Subsequent Windows and Node DNS lookups succeeded, as did the actual configured database SELECT 1 probe. The observed failure was DNS resolution before database authentication. The specific external resolver or network interruption could not be determined after recovery.
evidence.startupDefect: src/server.ts performed one connection probe and exited immediately when it failed. The web server then continued attempting to proxy requests to the stopped API.

how.implementation: A small database-startup helper retries only the read-only initial connection probe for recognized transient DNS, network and database-starting errors. It permits five probes with 1, 2, 4 and 8 second waits. Wrong credentials, missing database/schema and unrelated SQL failures are not retried.
how.diagnostics: Retry notices show the delay and attempt count. Exhausted DNS/network errors give actionable connection guidance without printing passwords, connection strings or raw SQL. Failed startup closes the pool.
how.scope: No application writes are replayed. No migrations, schema changes, credential resets, fixed-IP substitutions or Windows DNS changes are performed.

verification.focusedTests: 6 passed: recovery, retry exhaustion, immediate permanent failure, nested errors, first-probe success and sanitized diagnostics.
verification.apiHealth: http://localhost:4000/api/health — HTTP 200, schema ready, no missing tables or columns.
verification.limits: The live DNS fault had already recovered during diagnosis. Repeat failures and recovery were exercised through deterministic injected probes; system DNS was not deliberately broken. A lasting network outage or incorrect saved hostname still requires restoration or correction after retry exhaustion.

migrationTracking: Postgres 029 remains applied; enrollment 028 stays unapplied; next unused 030. MySQL reference 048 / next 049 unchanged.

changeLog.change: Added bounded startup recovery and safe terminal diagnostics, passed tests/build, restarted the API alongside the existing web server and verified the previously failing public catalog requests through Vite.
